review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Solution Consolidation & Architecture Lead the technical design, refactoring, and integration required to merge distinct software portfolios into a unified .NET 10 Core and Blazor architecture. Analyze functional workflows in existing applications (WebForms, Angular, REST APIs) and re-architect them into clean, maintainable Blazor Web Apps and microservices. Greenfield Development & New Requirements Drive end-to-end software development for incoming business feature requests
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Working under the direction of the Business Applications Manager, the role balances hands-on C#/.NET 10 coding with technical leadership, database architecture, and mentoring. Greenfield Development & New Requirements Drive end-to-end software development for incoming business feature requests, translating complex business processes into high-quality technical implementations. Data Access & Databases: Advanced SQL; expert-level proficiency in Oracle PL/SQL and PostgreSQL (query tuning, indexing, stored procedures, multi-tenant schema isolation). Strongly Preferred Skills Hands-on experience with SQL Server / Azure SQL . Domain-Driven Design (DDD) expertise.
